summary: This note is a statistical summary of the Cleveland Cavaliers–Golden State Warriors NBA rivalry, covering all meetings from the first game on October 17, 1970 through June 8, 2018. It records the all-time, regular-season and postseason head-to-head records, win streaks, and results of the four NBA Finals the teams met in from 2015 to 2018. The stats box lists 131 total meetings, but the all-time record of 73–59 adds up to 132, so the figures do not fully reconcile.
one_line: Statistical overview of the NBA rivalry between the Cleveland Cavaliers and Golden State Warriors, from their 1970 first meeting through 2018.
key_facts: The first meeting between the Cleveland Cavaliers and Golden State Warriors was on October 17, 1970, a Warriors 128, Cavaliers 108 win.
The latest meeting in the note was on June 8, 2018, a Warriors 108, Cavaliers 85 win.
The note lists the next meeting as N/A.
The note gives a total of 131 meetings between the teams.
The all-time series record is Warriors 73, Cavaliers 59.
The regular season series record is Warriors 59, Cavaliers 52.
The postseason results record is Warriors 15, Cavaliers 7.
The Cavaliers' longest win streak was 10 games, from 1992 to 1996.
The Warriors' longest win streak was 7 games, achieved in 2015–16 and in 2017–18.
The Warriors held a current win streak of 7 games at the time of the note.
The Warriors won the 2015 NBA Finals over the Cavaliers 4–2.
The Cavaliers won the 2016 NBA Finals over the Warriors 4–3.
The Warriors won the 2017 NBA Finals over the Cavaliers 4–1.
The Warriors won the 2018 NBA Finals over the Cavaliers 4–0.
